mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT trip_id as tripId, employee_id as employeeId, trip_type as tripType, destination as destination, start_datetime as startDatetime, end_datetime as endDatetime, reason as reason, approval_status as approvalStatus, reject_reason as rejectReason FROM business_trip_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY start_datetime DESC, trip_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT trip_id as tripId, employee_id as employeeId, trip_type as tripType, destination as destination, start_datetime as startDatetime, end_datetime as endDatetime, reason as reason, approval_status as approvalStatus, reject_reason as rejectReason FROM business_trip_request WHERE trip_id = #{tripId}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) as rejectedCount FROM business_trip_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
